description:
HTTP authentication module for MCP transports.
        Responsibilities:
        - McpAuthenticationFilter: extracts the Bearer token and populates the SecurityContextHolder
        - McpAuthenticationToken: Spring Security token with model.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.Jwt as the principal
        - TokenExtractor: converts provider.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.JwtClaims into the custom model.io.keelframework.mcp.common.jwt.Jwt
        - AuthAdapterAutoConfig: SecurityFilterChain and Spring Security beans
        - AuthAdapterProperties: keycloak.adapter.* configuration
        - McpAuthorizationAdvisor: AOP-based authorization by role/scope
        Depends on adapter-auth-idp for pure JWT validation.
